items.heading: Overview
items.paragraph:
This course focuses on everyday tools and best practices. We'll explain AI fundamentals, explore potential risks and how to overcome them, and demonstrate practical applications for your daily work. You'll learn how to write effective prompts and how to incorporate GenAI tools into your everyday work. We focus on how you can get the most out of these tools while also discussing the risks of using GenAI in public sector legal practice and how to mitigate them.

After each video ends, a continue button appears below the video player. Click it to reveal the additional navigation and the InnovateUS website link containing readings and resources. Learners with screen readers can use the down arrow key to navigate through the video player’s controls and access the continue button. Another “continue” button will appear to move on to the Self-Assessments after each video.

  • Reminder: Consult with your organization’s policies before using any tool or platform.  

  • Disclaimer: The commercial tools mentioned in this course are for illustrative purposes and do not imply endorsement by InnovateUS.

items.title: CONTINUE

answers.title: Role
Example

answers.feedback: RAG systems work with digital documents, not specifically handwritten ones

answers.feedback: RAG enhances but doesn't replace human legal research

items.title: When would RAG systems be most valuable for legal professionals?

answers.title: When needing creative writing for marketing materials
answers.feedback: Creative writing tasks benefit less from RAG's focus on specific documents

When learning basic programming concepts
answers.feedback: Programming education is not a primary legal application for RAG

answers.title: When seeking general information available to the public

description:
This course focuses on everyday tools and best practices. We'll explain AI fundamentals, explore potential risks and how to overcome them, and demonstrate practical applications for your daily work. You'll learn how to write effective prompts and how to incorporate GenAI tools into your everyday work. We focus on how you can get the most out of these tools while also discussing the risks of using GenAI in public sector legal practice and how to mitigate them.
